pages.title: Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Fill a picture with gems in Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting. Sort the crystals by color and put each one into a cell that calls for it. Work through the colors and watch the image take shape as the cells fill. The level is complete when the scattered gems have become a finished picture.

pages.title: Crazy Marble League
pages.creator: Rising Pixel
pages.description: Follow a season of physics-driven marble races in Crazy Marble League. Choose a marble to back and place an in-game bet before watching the race unfold. Hazards and boosts can change the order as the marbles roll through each course. See whether your favorite holds its lead all the way to the finish.

pages.title: Crystal Circuit
pages.creator: MythMash
pages.description: Send crystals onto a glowing loop in Crystal Circuit. Wait for a gap between the crystals already in motion, then launch the next one from the queue. A collision shatters the crystal and restarts the level. Empty the queue to advance to faster circuits with more traffic and different layouts.

pages.title: Idle Vlogger Simulator
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Start a channel and make videos in Idle Vlogger Simulator. Choose topics to cover as you work toward becoming one of the top creators. Improve your equipment and develop your skills between uploads. Decide where to invest next so you can make progress with the channel you've built.

pages.title: Space Cleaner
pages.creator: Mewton Games
pages.description: Clear asteroid fields around your ship in Space Cleaner. Use the mouse to destroy nearby asteroids and earn money while your fuel lasts. When the tank runs dry, spend your earnings on ship upgrades before heading out again. Destroy every asteroid in a field to unlock the next stage.

pages.title: Animal Racing Idle Park
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Train racers such as lions, eagles, orangutans, and dolphins in Animal Racing Idle Park. Build up your animals and put them into races that involve changing forms. The animals give you different options as the course changes. Keep training the racers you want to use and see how they perform in the next run.

pages.title: Coin Color Sort
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Sort coins into stacks of one color in Coin Color Sort. Look at which coins are available to move and choose a stack where they belong. Leave room for coins you need to set aside before completing a group. Clear the level by working through the mixed colors until the stacks are sorted.

pages.title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Clear winter-themed card layouts in Winter Solitaire TriPeaks. Play an exposed card one rank above or below your current card, and draw when you're out of moves. The game has more than 500 levels. As you progress, build winter locations that range from a cottage to a snow-covered palace.

pages.title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Make an ocean-themed jelly cake in Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake. Choose playful shapes and colors for the jelly, then add sea-inspired toppings to finish it. Think about how the decorations will look through the dessert. Try a different combination to create another underwater design.

pages.title: Color Hoop Sort
pages.creator: s1interactivestudio
pages.description: Sort colored hoops onto rods in Color Hoop Sort. Move hoops between rods and work toward a separate stack for each color. Think about which hoop needs to come off first to uncover another one. Later layouts give you more sorting to do, so keep an open spot for a move you'll need later.

pages.title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms in Back To School: Uniforms Edition. Try outfits inspired by countries including Japan, France, India, and South Korea. Choose accessories and a hairstyle to go with the uniform you've unlocked. Spin again to see how another school look changes the options.

pages.title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Dress a paper doll in fantasy styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up. Try pieces from the magical wardrobe and decide how you want the doll to look for each part of the diary. Change the outfit when you want to explore a different style. The paper doll format keeps the focus on combining pieces.

pages.title: Perfect Asmr Cleaning
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Take on cleaning and care tasks in Perfect Asmr Cleaning. Wash carpets, trim a cat's nails, and work through activities such as polishing teeth. Follow each task through its steps and listen to the sounds that go with the tools. The game moves between jobs around the home and personal care activities.

pages.title: Catch The Goose
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Send items from the grid to the tray in Catch The Goose. Three identical items disappear when they come together there, freeing room for more picks. Decide which set you can finish before sending down pieces that still need a match. Clear everything from the grid to catch the goose.

pages.title: The White Room 4
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Find a way out of a locked hotel room in The White Room 4. Examine the furniture and other objects for hidden clues, then use the tools you find to solve puzzles and work out passwords. Look for connections between clues before moving on. Each solved lock gets you closer to the exit.

pages.title: Merge Planets
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Combine planets in Merge Planets, a puzzle inspired by 2048. Drag planets together and look for merges that leave space for the next move. Keep building bigger planets as the arrangement changes. The galaxy grows out of the combinations you make, so think ahead before moving a piece into a crowded area.

pages.title: Shopaholic Black Friday
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Shop against the clock in Shopaholic Black Friday. Visit the mall to pick up clothes and accessories before time runs out, then use what you found to put together a look. Try lipstick, eye shadow, dresses, shoes, and bags as you style the character. Return for another shopping trip when you want a different outfit.

pages.title: Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Build an avatar in Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator. Mix hairstyles, clothes, hats, and accessories, then add details such as freckles, blush, wings, or tails. Decorate a room or create a street for your characters, and check the gacha for surprises. You can change the doll or its setting as you go.

pages.title: Hammer Master－Craft & Destroy!
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Swing a hammer through objects in Hammer Master－Craft & Destroy! Hold the mouse button and move side to side, or swipe by touch, to strike. Breaking things earns currency. Pick up crystals and combine them to craft a new hammer, then take it out to see what you can smash with it.

pages.title: Soccer Snakes
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Steer a snake toward the ball in Soccer Snakes. Release the players from their cages and use the side controls to turn. Line up a headbutt when you want to send the ball farther. Play alone or share the keyboard with a friend and see which snake can score more goals.

pages.title: Chicken Wars Merge Guns
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Defend the chickens' land in Chicken Wars Merge Guns. Merge chickens to create stronger defenders and position your forces against the incoming waves. Make upgrades during the battle and use power-ups when your line needs help. Keep the attackers from breaking through as the next wave comes in.

pages.title: Protect My Dog 3
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Draw a barrier between a dog and a swarm of bees in Protect My Dog 3. Use the mouse to sketch a line that holds up around the dog. Watch for lava, thorns, and other hazards that also need to be kept away. The 100 levels give you increasingly tricky places to draw your protection.

pages.title: Barbiemania
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Give Ellie three different makeup looks in Barbiemania. Choose cosmetics to fit each occasion and see how the colors work together on the doll. Use the mouse to try a different shade or detail before finishing. Each occasion gives you a reason to approach the makeover a little differently.

pages.title: Solitaire Classic
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Arrange cards in descending order with alternating colors in Solitaire Classic. Move cards to the four foundations when you can build each suit up from its ace. Tap or drag cards to rearrange the tableau, and draw from the stock when needed. Choose to turn over one or three cards at a time.

pages.title: Penguin Ice Breaker
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Break numbered icebergs in Penguin Ice Breaker. Use the arrow keys to move and jump, and check the number on each iceberg before you land on it. That number tells you how many jumps it takes to break the ice. Clear the icebergs needed to finish the level.

pages.title: Air Lift
pages.creator: MX Media & Entertainment Pte. Ltd
pages.description: Keep an upward-drifting balloon safe in Air Lift. Move your finger from side to side above it to clear blocks out of its path. Look ahead as the balloon rises so you can deal with the next obstacle before it comes too close. The run continues as long as the balloon makes it through.

pages.title: Paper Fighter 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Win two rounds to take the match in Paper Fighter 3D. Use punches and kicks when your opponent comes within reach, then use your special strike once the power bar fills. Fight on your own or share the keyboard with a second player. The paper-layered arenas give the bouts their distinctive look.

pages.title: Stickman vs Craftsman
pages.creator: Lunar
pages.description: Find a way home from a block-built world in Stickman vs Craftsman. In Story Mode, look for the key to the next door and fight enemies with arrows, bombs, or close-range attacks. Collect coins to buy costumes and pick up diamonds for your ranking. Try Survival Mode to see what you can gather under pressure.

pages.title: Lady Strange and Ruby Witch
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two comic-book heroines in Lady Strange and Ruby Witch. Choose a costume for each protector, then put together the makeup, hairstyle, and accessories to match. Try pieces from the wardrobe until both looks feel distinct. The two characters share a mission but can have very different styles.

pages.title: Glow Blast !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Set off a chain reaction in Glow Blast ! Click or tap a numbered glow dot to make it burst and trigger nearby dots. Look at how the pieces are arranged before choosing which one starts the reaction. Clear every dot from the screen to solve the puzzle and move on.

pages.title: MineWarfire Land Defense
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Stop invading mine zombies in MineWarfire Land Defense. Use the mouse on a computer or drag the onscreen joystick on a touch device to move your defender. Watch where the attackers are coming from and shift your position to fight them off. Keep them from taking over your territory.

pages.title: Xonicz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Cut off parts of the playing field before time runs out in Xonicz! Move the cursor with the arrow keys to draw a cut. Keep the moving balls from crossing the unfinished line, and avoid crossing your own path. Look for a gap that gives you enough time to finish the cut.

pages.title: Mate in One Move
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Find the single move that delivers checkmate in Mate in One Move. Look at which squares the opposing king can escape to and choose a move that covers them. Puzzles are grouped by the pieces doing the mating, from a lone rook or queen to pairs of bishops, knights, and other combinations.

pages.title: Train Surfers
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Run along busy tracks to get away from the police in Train Surfers. Jump, slide, or change lanes to avoid trains, buses, and barriers. Collect coins along the route and spend them on power-ups, or unlock new characters to try. Keep moving and see how far you can make it.

pages.title: TonkWars.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Battle other players' tanks in TonkWars.io. Move with the mouse and click to shoot through enemies and destructible terrain. Pick up power-ups as you explore different areas and use the changing terrain when choosing where to fight. Customize your tank with flags and hats to change its appearance.

pages.title: Ugi Bugi
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a blue teddy bear to the flag in Ugi Bugi. Move through the course with WASD or the touch controls and watch for obstacles between the bear and the finish. Collect gold along the way when you can reach it safely. Get to the flag to complete the route.

pages.title: Power Connect Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Turn paths and monsters to link them with potions in Power Connect Halloween. Tap a piece to rotate it and look at how its open ends line up with the pieces beside it. Connect the monsters to the magical potions to summon them. Check the whole route when a connection still has a gap.

pages.title: Halloween Wheelie Bike
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Balance a bike on one wheel in Halloween Wheelie Bike. Use the mouse to adjust the bike and watch how far it tips while the Death King rides. Keep the front wheel up without leaning back too far. See how much ground you can cover before the wheelie ends.

pages.title: Rescue Helicopter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fly a helicopter to pick up people in Rescue Helicopter. Use taps to control the aircraft as you approach someone who needs help. Judge the height of the helicopter as you move into position. Keep going through the rescue course and try to reach the people you find along the way.

pages.title: Shaun The Sheep Flock Together
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide falling sheep into matching groups in Shaun The Sheep Flock Together. Use the arrow keys to position the flock so sheep in the same leotards come together. Keep the pile below the bunting as more sheep fall. Herd as many as you can to safety before the space fills up.

pages.title: Village Of Monsters
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap blocks to make horizontal or vertical matches in Village Of Monsters. Group at least three identical candies to unlock and clear the tiles. Check which tiles are still covered before choosing your next move, and use power-ups when they can help you finish a board. There are 36 levels to solve.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Party Prep
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help four princesses prepare for their Halloween party in Princess Halloween Party Prep. Choose makeup and change their clothes to put together costumes before the celebration starts. Work on each princess's look in turn. Once they're ready, join them at the party and see the costumes together.

pages.title: Real Car Parking Jigsaw
pages.creator: GameZing
pages.description: Guide a vehicle into its parking spot in Real Car Parking Jigsaw. Use the arrow keys to drive and check how much room you have before turning into a tight space. Line up the car carefully so you can reach the spot without clipping what's around it. Work through the levels as the parking maneuvers get harder.

pages.title: Tetris Mobile
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Build full horizontal rows from falling pieces in Tetris Mobile. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move each piece, and press Up on a keyboard to rotate it. Clear rows to score points and free up room. Look at the gaps in the stack before deciding where the next shape should land.

pages.title: Dino Rock
pages.creator: Manifesto Games
pages.description: Play a series of shows with a band in Dino Rock. Tap or click the musical buttons in time with the songs and see how accurately you can follow each rhythm. Work through the challenges and build up the band's following. Replay a performance to improve your record or try for a perfect score.

pages.title: Monster Matching
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Connect at least three matching monsters in Monster Matching. You can draw the chain in different directions, so look beyond the pieces directly beside each other in a row. Clear long groups where you can and watch the timer while the board changes. Try to take out as many monsters as possible before time runs out.

pages.title: Real MTB Downhill 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Ride a mountain bike down five routes in Real MTB Downhill 3D. Reach the end before the timer runs out while dealing with rough terrain and changes in the weather. Use your rewards to change the bike's color or get new riding clothes. Each route gives you a different stretch of mountain to get through.

pages.title: Colors Car Cartoon
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Paint cartoon cars in Colors Car Cartoon. Use the mouse to select and apply colors, then decide how the bodywork and smaller details should look together. Try a single palette across the car or give different sections their own colors. Move on to another drawing when you're happy with the result.

pages.title: Johnny Revenge
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take on the mafia in Johnny Revenge. Use the mouse or touch to time your shots as enemies come within reach. Watch where your aim is going before you fire, since you'll have to keep moving through the encounters. Clear the gunmen standing between you and the next stretch.

pages.title: Burger
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare a hamburger by following the recipe in Burger. Work through the game's instructions to make the patty and assemble the sandwich in its bun. Add the toppings as the recipe calls for them. The game takes you through the preparation step by step until the burger is ready.

pages.title: BTS Easter Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color Easter drawings in BTS Easter Coloring Book. Pick a design, such as an Easter egg, and use the mouse or touch to add the colors you want. Change the palette when you want a different look. Save your finished picture if you'd like to keep or share it.

pages.title: Narrow Passage
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a ball through rotating obstacles in Narrow Passage. Click or tap to move when an opening comes around. Look at where the gap will be when the ball reaches it, then time your move through the narrow space. See how many shapes you can pass before the ball crashes.

pages.title: Newtonian Inversion
pages.creator: The Voices Games
pages.description: Reach the exit teleporter by reversing gravity in Newtonian Inversion. Move and jump between gravity panels, then use the gravity gun in levels where it's available. Aim at a panel and fire to change which way you fall. Look for the next surface you can reach as you plan your route.

pages.title: Dumbocalypse
pages.creator: Monish Vyas
pages.description: Answer people's questions after a failed experiment in Dumbocalypse. Professor Brain's app gives you a way to help, but each reply affects the planet's balance. Think about how your choices could change the population or make people too happy or too sad. Keep those measures in balance as more questions come in.

pages.title: Pixel Slime
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Jump, twist, and glide through 40 courses in Pixel Slime. The slime moves automatically, so use a click or tap to jump as hazards come up. Look ahead and time your moves to avoid deaths. The challenge is to finish with the lowest score you can manage.

pages.title: Car Parking Pro
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Draw a route into the parking space in Car Parking Pro. Use the mouse or your finger to trace where the car should go, then see whether it reaches its spot safely. Look at the whole approach before drawing the line. The route matters as much as where it ends.

pages.title: Beach Date
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help a couple steal a kiss in Beach Date. Use the mouse or tap to play and watch for other people who might interrupt them. Pick moments when the couple has some privacy. The challenge is keeping their date going without letting the people around them spoil the moment.

pages.title: Mega Water Surface Car Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Race floating cars on water slides and surf tracks in Mega Water Surface Car Racing Game 3D. Guide the car through water park routes and try stunts while keeping it under control. Work through turns and drifting sections as you build speed. The water courses give the cars a different kind of surface to race on.

pages.title: Mermaid Sea Adventure
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Explore a mermaid's underwater city in Mermaid Sea Adventure. Use the mouse to move through the activities, solve puzzles by working with their pieces, and try different outfits in the dress-up scenes. Follow the mermaid princess through the levels to discover the next part of the city.

pages.title: Warehouse Truck Parking
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Park a truck in tight spaces in Warehouse Truck Parking. Use the arrow keys to guide the vehicle through the warehouse and line it up with the parking spot. Check the space around the truck before turning. The narrow approaches make it important to plan how you'll pull in.

pages.title: Hurdles
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Choose one of eight runners and compete across 12 stages in Hurdles. Press Space or use the jump button as each hurdle comes up. A well-timed jump earns more points and helps you stay ahead of the other runners. Finish on the podium to qualify for the next race.

pages.title: Christmas Balloons
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Pop the Christmas balloons as quickly as you can in Christmas Balloons. Use the mouse to click the balloons, but leave the red ones alone. Look at the color of each balloon before you click, especially when several are close together. The challenge is moving quickly without choosing the wrong one.

pages.title: 4x4 offroad simulator 2020
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take a four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive vehicle off-road in 4x4 offroad simulator 2020. Choose among three maps and try the available cars and jeeps on different terrain. Use the arrow keys to accelerate, steer, and reverse, and Space to brake. See how your chosen vehicle handles the route.

pages.title: Angry Fish
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Launch fish at chickens in Angry Fish. Aim with touch and release to send a fish into the scene. Use its special ability to get through barriers and reach targets behind them. Clear the chickens to unlock more maps, with 15 different layouts to work through.

pages.title: Evil Non Scary Horror Game Adventure
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Find a way out of a school watched by a nun in Evil Non Scary Horror Game Adventure. Keep quiet and hide when she's close, since she can hear noises that give away your position. Explore the school and nearby areas for ways to solve the puzzles. Get out before she catches you.

pages.title: Santa's Flight
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Launch Santa and see how far he flies in Santa's Flight. Click or tap to start the flight, then tap Santa to use a cookie for a boost. Collect candies along the way and visit the store for upgrades. There are 12 items to improve as you work toward a longer flight.

pages.title: Ludo classic : a dice game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Roll the dice and move your pawns in Ludo classic : a dice game. Decide which pawn to advance on each turn and work toward bringing your pieces to the end. Play on your own or against friends. The dice determine what moves are available, so use each roll to help the pawn that needs it most.

pages.title: ShooterZ.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Create a room or join someone else's match in ShooterZ.io. Fight other players in several environments, using the mouse to aim and fire and R to reload. Switch weapons with the number keys and crouch, jump, or run when you need to reposition. The in-game chat lets you talk with the players in your room.

pages.title: Roll Run 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Roll a ball to its destination in Roll Run 3D. Tap or click to move it and watch the obstacles between the ball and the finish. Choose when to roll so you can get through an opening while the route is clear. Reach the end without running into the hazards along the way.

pages.title: Sushi Slice
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Slice sushi with the mouse in Sushi Slice. Click and move through the sushi as it comes into view, but keep your path clear of bombs. The game has two types of sushi and bonuses to pick up as you go. Keep slicing through the endless round without hitting the wrong target.

pages.title: Narrow Passage Halloween
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Jump through obstacles as the walls close in during Narrow Passage Halloween. Tap or click to move upward and time your jump through each gap. Waiting makes the passage narrower, so look for an opening before the walls leave too little room. Keep going to build your score without getting crushed.

pages.title: Connect Animals : Onet Kyodai
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear pairs of matching animal tiles in Connect Animals : Onet Kyodai. Look for two tiles with the same picture that you can link across the board. Removing one pair opens space for more connections. Keep checking the available routes until you've found every match.

pages.title: BTS Apple Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an apple drawing and color it in BTS Apple Coloring Book. Pick colors for the fruit and the details around it, then fill the picture in a part at a time. Try a different palette or switch to another picture when you want a new design to work on.

pages.title: Stickman Warrior Fatality
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Punch and kick your way through fights in Stickman Warrior Fatality. Use the stickman's movement to land blows and handle opponents as they come at you. Collect stars and spend them on weapons to use against harder enemies. Work through the levels and see which moves help you stay in the fight.

pages.title: Stay on Road
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Drift around corners in Stay on Road. Watch the next turn as your car approaches and time the drift so you stay on the track. The goal is to complete as many laps as you can without crashing. Use each lap to get a better feel for when the car needs to turn.

pages.title: Idle Factory
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Build a factory business in Idle Factory. Start producing and use your earnings to hire more workers. As the factory grows, decide when to put money back into the operation so it can bring in more. Work your way up from the early jobs to a larger factory.

pages.title: Falling Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Control your descent with a parachute in Falling Game. Click the left mouse button or press Space to open it and slow down when you need more time to react. Watch for obstacles and pick up gems as you fall. Reach the finish line to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Red Ball Puzzle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Move or rotate objects to guide a ball in Red Ball Puzzle. Click or tap the pieces and look at how each change affects the route toward the goal. Think ahead about where the ball will go after it meets the first object. Adjust the layout until it can reach the finish.

pages.title: Basketball Stars
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Choose a team and hit the court in Basketball Stars. Shoot three-pointers, go for dunks, or block and steal when the other side has the ball. Watch the supershot meter and use the special dunk once it fills. Enter a tournament or play a two-player game against someone on the same keyboard.

pages.title: Puppy Rescue
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fly a helicopter to rescue stranded puppies in Puppy Rescue. Pick them up and take them to safety without crashing into aircraft, hot-air balloons, or moving platforms. Start with the interactive tutorial if you want to get used to flying. Work through more than 20 levels and try to earn three stars on the rescues.

pages.title: Animal hunters
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Use a sniper rifle to hunt animals such as deer, rabbits, wolves, and birds in Animal hunters. Use the right mouse button to look through the scope and the left button to shoot. Earn money from the hunts and spend it on equipment upgrades. Choose the improvements you want before going out again.

pages.title: Golf Royale
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Take on a series of golf challenges in Golf Royale. Look at the route and the obstacles between the ball and its target before you take the shot. Adjust the direction and strength to suit the section you're playing. Work through the course one shot at a time until you reach the end.

pages.title: Bullet Fire 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Clear 100 enemies as quickly as possible in Bullet Fire 2. Move through the first-person shooter and watch for enemies you haven't dealt with yet. Line up shots as targets come into view and keep moving through the encounter. The challenge is finishing the whole group in less time.

pages.title: Tap Cricket
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Bat against a bowler in Tap Cricket. Watch the delivery and time your swing to send the ball past the fielders. The game tracks the balls and runs you have left as you chase a target. Look for fours and sixes when the delivery gives you a chance to score quickly.

pages.title: Exotic Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of exotic animals in Exotic Animals Jigsaw. Pick a scene and select Easy, Medium, or Hard. Match details such as animal markings and background colors across the pieces. There's no time limit, so you can work at your own pace or return to the same picture on a harder setting.

pages.title: Impossible Bottle Flip
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Flip a bottle across a course in Impossible Bottle Flip. Tap when you're ready to send it toward the next landing spot. Watch where the bottle comes down so you can judge when to start the following flip. Keep landing in the right places until you get it to the destination.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Arcade
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Play Xs and Os against the computer in Tic Tac Toe Arcade. Choose an empty square to place your mark and try to make a line of three across, down, or diagonally. Watch for a line the computer is about to finish. Sometimes you need to block its move before setting up your own.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture and fill it with color in Kids Coloring Book. Use the brush and pick a color from the palette, then decide what to paint next. Work on the main shapes first or start with the smaller details. Try another drawing when you're ready to use a different set of colors.

pages.title: Jumping Burger
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Jump over ketchup bottles, birds, and mice in Jumping Burger. Your burger slides forward on its own, so time the jumps to get past obstacles and collect ingredients along the way. Look for lettuce, cheese, patties, and other toppings. Pick up a chili for temporary invincibility and see how far you can go.

pages.title: Blaze Monster Machines Crush
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Make rows of matching monster trucks in Blaze Monster Machines Crush. Bring three or more of the same machine together to score points and clear them. Look for trucks that are already close to forming a row, then see what the match opens up on the board for the next move.

pages.title: Masked Forces 3
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight across three large maps in Masked Forces 3. Choose deathmatch, team deathmatch, battle royale, or DOOM mode, and add bots to a room if you want them. Look for power-ups such as regeneration and shields. Level up to access more weapons and skins, and customize your armor and mask.

pages.title: Super Stickman Biker
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Ride a chopper through obstacle courses in Super Stickman Biker. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to keep your balance over rough sections and try wheelies and other stunts. Collect pieces and use them to get new bikes. Try a faster ride when you want to tackle the track differently.

pages.title: Words Family
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Fit letter pieces together to make words in Words Family. Drag the pieces onto the grid and check which words appear where their letters meet. A word that fits by itself still has to leave room for the remaining pieces. Fill the grid to solve each of the 39 levels.

pages.title: Village Story
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Get people and animals across a river in Village Story. Tap passengers to put them on the raft and use the raft button to send it across. Read the rules for each crossing before moving anyone. Quicker solutions can earn more stars, and the help icon is available if a riddle stalls you.

pages.title: BFFs Ice Cafe Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress Jasmine, Elsa, Anna, and Aurora for a party in BFFs Ice Cafe Party. Choose cocktail dresses and pair them with coats or leather jackets that suit the cold setting. Try a different combination for each princess. The outfits have to work for an evening out and for the ice café itself.

pages.title: Candy Girl Dressup
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Choose a party outfit in Candy Girl Dressup. Browse the clothes and accessories, and try them together to see what suits the character. Pick a few details to go with the outfit before she heads out. You can swap individual items or put together a different party look.

pages.title: Retro Speed 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take a car into a top-down arcade race in Retro Speed 2. Steer with the mouse or touch and look ahead to see where you can get past the other cars. Use upgrades to improve the car between runs. See how long you can keep driving as the traffic gets in your way.

pages.title: Iphone X Makeover
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Repair Elsa's damaged phone in Iphone X Makeover. Open the case, remove and replace the broken internal parts, then put in a new screen. Clean the phone after the repair and work through the makeover steps. Use the mouse or touch to handle each part of the job.

pages.title: Drone Delivery
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fly packages across a busy city in Drone Delivery. Use the arrow keys to control the drone and steer around buildings and other obstacles on the way to the drop-off. Look at what lies ahead before changing direction. Make the deliveries without letting the drone crash.

pages.title: Twisted City
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Join pieces of road by turning them in Twisted City. Click or tap to rotate a section and check how its ends line up with the streets next to it. Work through the layout until the route connects. The puzzles use the same kind of rotation as a pipe-connecting game.

pages.title: Barbie Glam Queen
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Put together a glam look in Barbie Glam Queen. Browse Barbie's designer wardrobe and choose pieces that work together from head to toe. Try different outfits before deciding which one fits the style you're after. Finish by choosing the details that make the look feel complete.

pages.title: Fashion Diva's
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style Ellie and Anne for their first runway show in Fashion Diva's. Choose an outfit for each new model and see how the pieces look together before the show begins. Give them different styles or put together looks that share a theme. The goal is to have both ready for their debut.
